Park the vehicle: - Always park the vehicle on a flat and stable surface.
- Apply the electronic parking brake before leaving the vehicle.
- Engage gear P and switch off the drive system.
- Ensure all windows and doors are closed before locking.
Electronic parking brake: - Activates automatically when the vehicle is turned off.
- Can be engaged manually by pulling the switch.
- Releases automatically when driving off with gear engaged.
- A warning light indicates the status of the parking brake.
General information on parking systems: - Parking systems assist the driver during parking manoeuvres.
- Use ultrasonic sensors and cameras to detect obstacles.
- The system may not detect low or small objects.
- Always supervise the parking process and be ready to intervene.
Park Distance Control Plus (Park Pilot): - Provides visual and acoustic feedback about distances to obstacles.
- Active when reversing or manually activated.
- Shows a top-down display on the infotainment screen.
- Audible tones increase in frequency as obstacles get closer.
Intelligent Park Assist (IPA) automatic: - Automatically steers the vehicle into parking spaces.
- The driver controls acceleration, braking, and gear selection.
- Works with both parallel and perpendicular parking spots.
- Visual prompts assist the driver during the manoeuvre.
Automatic Parking System Plus with memor: - Learns and stores frequent parking manoeuvres.
- Activated manually or automatically when near stored locations.
- Assists with repetitive parking in familiar spots.
- Allows the driver to monitor and intervene at any time.
Automatic parking system plus with remot: - Enables parking manoeuvres using the My CUPRA App.
- The driver can control the vehicle from outside.
- Useful in tight spaces where entry/exit is difficult.
- Requires confirmation via smartphone before executing.
Reverse Assist (Rear View Camera): - Activates automatically when selecting reverse gear.
- Provides a wide-angle view behind the vehicle.
- Guidelines help estimate distance and trajectory.
- Keep the camera lens clean for optimal performance.
Peripheral view system (Top View Camera): - Offers a 360° view of the surroundings.
- Helps in tight manoeuvring and detecting low obstacles.
- Displayed on the infotainment screen in real time.
Rear Cross Traffic Alert: - Warns of crossing traffic when reversing.
- Uses radar sensors to detect movement from the sides.
- May apply braking in critical situations to avoid collisions.
Exit Warning: - Alerts occupants of approaching traffic before opening doors.
- Uses radar to monitor the vehicle's surroundings.
- Visual and acoustic warnings are triggered.
- Enhances safety when exiting in traffic or narrow spaces.
